    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.genericCopresentation_numerical_pair_of_rigid {k R D : Type u} [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [DivisionRing D] [Algebra k D] {I J : Type u} [AddCommGroup I] [Module k I] [Module R I] [IsScalarTower k R I] [AddCommGroup J] [Module k J] [Module R J] [IsScalarTower k R J] {n : Type u} [Fintype n] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite R I] [Module.Finite R J] (injI : Module.Injective R I) (injJ : Module.Injective R J) (h : Module.Basis n k (I →ₗ[R] J)) (g : FreeAlgebra k n →ₐ[k] D) (rigid : ∀ (f : ↧(TensorProduct k I D) ⟶ ↧(TensorProduct k J D)), ∃ (a : ↧(TensorProduct k I D) ⟶ ↧(TensorProduct k I D)) (c : ↧(TensorProduct k J D) ⟶ ↧(TensorProduct k J D)), f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a (genericCopresentation h g) + CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (genericCopresentation h g) c) (θ : Weight (FGModuleCat R)) (he : ∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), θ.eval X = ↑(Module.finrank k (↑X →ₗ[R] J)) - ↑(Module.finrank k (↑X →ₗ[R] I))) :
    perpendicularToModule (CategoryTheory.Limits.kernel (genericCopresentation h g)) = θ.weakTorsionClass ∧ cogeneratedByModule (CategoryTheory.Limits.kernel (genericCopresentation h g)) = fun (X : FGModuleCat R) => ∀ {U : FGModuleCat R} (i : U ⟶ X) [CategoryTheory.Mono i], ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero U → θ.eval U < 0

    The ground-field difference of Hom dimensions determines the numerical torsion pair, with no dimension hypotheses over the localization left to check.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_endofinite_kernel_of_commutators {k R : Type u} [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] [Module.Finite k R] (coefficients : ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V], ∃ (K : Type u) (x : DivisionRing K) (x_1 : Algebra k K) (a : V → K), HasSurjectiveCommutators k a) (γ : ProjectiveClass R) :
    ∃ (N : ModuleCat R), IsEndofinite N ∧ SplitsOnCogeneratedModules k N ∧ perpendicularToModule N = ((projectiveClassWeight k) γ).weakTorsionClass ∧ cogeneratedByModule N = fun (X : FGModuleCat R) => ∀ {U : FGModuleCat R} (i : U ⟶ X) [CategoryTheory.Mono i], ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero U → ((projectiveClassWeight k) γ).eval U < 0

    Coefficients solving all simultaneous commutator equations realize every integral weight by an endofinite kernel.

    ∃ (N : ModuleCat R), IsEndofinite N ∧ SplitsOnCogeneratedModules k N ∧ perpendicularToModule N = ((projectiveClassWeight k) γ).weakTorsionClass ∧ cogeneratedByModule N = fun (X : FGModuleCat R) => ∀ {U : FGModuleCat R} (i : U ⟶ X) [CategoryTheory.Mono i], ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero U → ((projectiveClassWeight k) γ).eval U < 0

    A division-ring universal localization of each finite free algebra suffices to realize every integral weight by an endofinite kernel.
